## Interactive: how `BLOCK_SIZE` tiles a 1D tensor

This widget visualizes how a 1D tensor of length `N` is covered by program
instances when each program owns one tile of size `BLOCK_SIZE`. Drag the
sliders to see how the grid changes — in particular, watch the final
(rightmost) tile when `N` is not a multiple of `BLOCK_SIZE`. The shaded
portion of that tile is the part that needs a mask in the kernel.

Copy this whole block into a chapter and change the defaults at the top. Keep
the comments — they explain to the reader what they are looking at.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| label: fig-grid-mapping-template
//| fig-cap: "Template: per-program tile coverage of a length-N 1D tensor by BLOCK_SIZE lanes. Steel-blue cells are in-bounds, light-gray cells are masked tail lanes."

// --- Inputs -------------------------------------------------------------
viewof N = Inputs.range([1, 64], {value: 17, step: 1, label: "N (tensor length)"})
viewof BLOCK_SIZE = Inputs.range([1, 32], {value: 4, step: 1, label: "BLOCK_SIZE"})

// --- Derived ------------------------------------------------------------
num_programs = Math.ceil(N / BLOCK_SIZE)

// Build one record per program with its element indices and a flag for
// which lanes are masked off (out of bounds).
tiles = {
  const out = [];
  for (let pid = 0; pid < num_programs; pid++) {
    const start = pid * BLOCK_SIZE;
    for (let lane = 0; lane < BLOCK_SIZE; lane++) {
      const idx = start + lane;
      out.push({
        pid: pid,
        lane: lane,
        index: idx,
        in_bounds: idx < N
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// --- Render -------------------------------------------------------------
// One row per program, lanes laid out left-to-right. In-bounds lanes are
// solid; masked lanes are hatched/faded so the reader can see exactly which
// values need `mask=...` on the `tl.load` / `tl.store`.
Plot.plot({
  width: 720,
  height: 60 + num_programs * 32,
  x: {label: "lane within program", domain: [-0.5, BLOCK_SIZE - 0.5]},
  y: {label: "program id (pid)", domain: [-0.5, num_programs - 0.5], reverse: true},
  color: {legend: true, domain: ["in-bounds", "masked"], range: ["steelblue", "lightgray"]},
  marks: [
    Plot.cell(tiles, {
      x: "lane",
      y: "pid",
      fill: d => d.in_bounds ? "in-bounds" : "masked",
      stroke: "white",
      title: d => `pid=${d.pid} lane=${d.lane} index=${d.index} ${d.in_bounds ? "" : "(masked)"}`
    }),
    Plot.text(tiles, {
      x: "lane",
      y: "pid",
      text: d => d.in_bounds ? `${d.index}` : "x",
      fill: "white",
      fontSize: 11
    })
  ]
})

md`**Grid size:** ${num_programs} program(s). **Masked lanes in last tile:** ${
  num_programs * BLOCK_SIZE - N
}.`
```
